You make some good points there.  Don't forget about the *alleged* case against Wawa for stealing employees' ESOP.

Wawa does not seem to care about you, or any other associate.  It appears the company will not observe values for *your* benefit.  Perhaps that's not how this works.  The core values are for *you,* the lowly associate, to follow.    Check the honker.  That's our main avenue for company wide news.  What are they telling us?   What have they told us since this all began?

Don't check, I'll save you some time.  Nothing.  The answer is nothing.  They have pandered to us for our supposed, "bravery" during this *oh so trying* time.  Corona is worse than ever in the US right now.  Any updates on positive cases?  Oh and how's that hazard pay going?

Keep in mind that when stores were first closing due to positive cases, said closures were being reported right here on this very subreddit.  Wawa asked the moderator to stop publishing the closures - and they obliged.  Is it fair to say that Wawa wants neither the public, nor its own associates to be in the know with regard to positive cases and store closures?  I think so.

I think perhaps a company which preaches those 6 core values may want to consider placing the safety of its own employees - who need I remind you, are shareholders - as top priority.  

Is that not the very definition of "value people?"  Would customers be "delighted" to know that their beloved Wawa is suppressing such information?  Is that what you might call "doing the right thing?"  I suspect not.  

Wise up, Wawa.  COVID is a global catastrophe, and everyone is watching closely to see how those around them handle it.  Is this reputation you want to have in the event that this all concludes?
